rows.text: returns 0 when `edx` is 0; otherwise the buffer is `rcx+8` when `edx` is 1, or the result of the call at `006C7450` + 0x42 with `edx`*8 and 8 when `edx` is above 1 (a null result is returned as is); into a non-null buffer it copies `r9d` qwords from `r8` and zero-fills the remaining `edx` minus `r9d` qwords with `rep stosq`, and returns the buffer

notes: 006C7450: the copy loop tests each destination slot pointer for null (placement-new idiom) and advances the source only when it writes; no check guards r9d above edx (the zero-fill count would then underflow).
